name: Green Mountain
author: FloxMi
description: Press and hold the green orb in the middle at 25% (or time a jump and hold from the left edge of the platform at 25%) so you go between the gears at 27% when you enter the ship portal. Stop holding the moment you go between the gears to avoid the invisible moving spike and to land on the platform at 28% when your inputs are disabled. Fall up until your icon is near the ceiling where you can then stay at a constant position until the end from there.
